style-rfb-rfb.title: RFMO/RFB Boundaries PMTiles by RFB
style-rfb-rfb.description: Features coloured by RFB, 12 of 54 values, the rest grey. Colours the twelve RFMOs that manage high-seas fisheries (four tuna commissions and eight area-based bodies); the other 42 advisory, inland and coastal bodies are grouped as Other.

style-vme-owner.title: VME Closures PMTiles by OWNER
style-vme-owner.description: Features coloured by OWNER, 8 values. Each VME closure is set by one RFMO, so colouring by the establishing body shows who regulates each area.
